name: Movement — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Movement from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Movement" but are not part of the Movement entry, which is unchanged.

Table: Terrain and Overland Movement
Terrain	Highway	Road or Trail	Trackless
Desert, sandy	×1	×1/2	×1/2
Forest	×1	×1	×1/2
Hills	×1	×3/4	×1/2
Jungle	×1	×3/4	×1/4
Moor	×1	×1	×3/4
Mountains	×3/4	×3/4	×1/2
Plains	×1	×1	×3/4
Swamp	×1	×3/4	×1/2
Tundra, frozen	×1	×3/4	×3/4
Special Movement Types

The following information is collected from various locations and placed here for your convenience.

See the Climb skill for further details.

Fly

Creatures with a fly speed receive the Fly skill for free as a class skill.

Maneuverability: Creatures with a fly speed receive a bonus (or penalty) on all Fly checks depending on their maneuverability:

Source not confirmed for this entry. If this is your work, use the Feedback link below to let us know so we can credit it properly.
